name: RecoverRX Physical Therapy
why: Physical therapy on the same Butterfield Road corridor, one mile out. Discharged and between-visit patients need exactly the recovery tools ETHR sells, and the name says the same thing.

name: Jevitz Chiropractic & Physical Therapy
why: Elmhurst chiropractic and physical therapy under one roof, 5.0 across 340+ reviews. Sports and post-injury caseload with no recovery suite on site.

name: Soma Healthcare Center: Lawrence Rugg, D.C.
why: Dr Rugg's chiropractic practice in Elmhurst, 5.0 across 70+ reviews. A single-doctor office, where one recommendation carries the whole room. A second office in Chicago is far outside the ring.

name: Cordoba Health Group
why: Chiropractic and medical care under a mile up Butterfield Road, 4.9 across 56 reviews. Pain and mobility patients walk in for the same reasons people book HBOT and red light.

name: E-Town Fitness
why: Independent Elmhurst personal-training gym, 5.0 across 230+ reviews. Trainers see soreness and stalled progress weekly and have a front desk to hand a card over.

name: Just Lift Fitness
why: Clarendon Hills strength-training studio, 5.0 across 330+ reviews, in the highest-bid town on ETHR's own ads map. Lifters are cryo and compression buyers.

name: i.e. Fitness
why: Independent Westmont gym with coached and open floors, 5.0 across 89 reviews. Members training several times a week are the strongest referral group the portal recognises.

name: Team Kuma Jiu Jitsu Academy
why: Downers Grove jiu jitsu academy, 5.0 across 210+ reviews. Grapplers train hurt all year: the highest natural demand for HBOT and cryo in the batch.

name: Iron Flag Fitness
why: Westmont strength and conditioning gym, 5.0 across 190+ reviews. Small-group coaching floor where a trainer's word carries more than a flyer.

name: Vuk BJJ
why: Elmhurst jiu jitsu gym, 5.0 across 160+ reviews. Same recovery need as Team Kuma, different town, so the two do not cannibalise each other.

name: The Great Little Bike Shop
why: Independent Westmont bike shop next door to i.e. Fitness, 4.9 across 117 reviews. Riders logging long weekend miles turn up sore on Monday.

name: Pure Muay Thai and Fitness Club LLC
why: Westmont Muay Thai gym, locally owned since 2018 per its own site, 4.9 across 90+ reviews. Striking punishes shins and joints; cryo is the obvious next booking.

name: Rising Goddess Fitness
why: Westmont pole and aerial studio, 4.9 across 150 reviews. Grip, shoulder and hip load every session, and a membership that already pays monthly to look after its body.

name: FORM Physical Therapy
why: Westchester physical therapy clinic at the western edge of the five miles, 5.0 across 150+ reviews. Performance-framed PT, the same athlete ETHR's ads target.

name: Sky Centers Martial Arts
why: Lombard martial arts school with kids, teens and adult programmes under one roof, 4.9 across 150+ reviews. Parents in the lobby and adults sparring at night: both halves of the audience ETHR's ads already pay for.
